title: Archive 81
subtitle: Found-footage horror about ritual, sound, and the feeling that a recording can bite back.
description: An archival horror series that starts with restored tapes and keeps widening into stranger rituals, cities, broadcasts, and buried histories.

length.label: Official site says the show has released three seasons and two miniseries, with more to come.

archiveTake: One of the better escalation picks when the listener wants horror to get weirder, more structural, and more sound-driven.

similarReasons.the-white-vault: A colder isolation-horror neighbor if you want the setting itself to feel more hostile.
similarReasons.tower-4: Keeps the remote-post suspicion active in a more grounded mystery shape.
similarReasons.malevolent: A darker occult escalation once the sound-led weirdness needs a more intimate supernatural bond.
